name: astChebyMap
note: C reads lbnd_i/ubnd_i whenever inverse coefficients are given and dereferences a NULL; the port refuses the call with Badin. name: Frame
note: A plain Frame does not implement Mapping, where C's Frame is a unit Mapping with Nin = Nout = Naxes (PLAN.md 9.6: a bare Frame in a Mapping slot is not supported)

name: astAxAngle
note: C's header gives -PI/2 to +PI/2 for a 2-D Frame; the code returns astAngle's -PI to +PI, as the port's doc says (docs/issues/c-library-quirks.md)

name: astAxNorm
note: C's header says SkyFrame latitudes always go into -PI to +PI; a SkyFrame's own SkyAxes are not latitude axes in C's code, and the port mirrors that (docs/issues/c-library-quirks.md)

name: astConvert
note: C sets the Base of a FrameSet argument to the Frame used for the conversion; the port takes both by shared reference and leaves them unchanged (PLAN.md 2). C considers the intermediate Frames of an inverted FrameSet in reverse order; the port always uses ascending index order (PLAN.md 2)

name: astFindFrame
note: C sets the Current of a FrameSet target to the Frame matched; the port leaves it unchanged (PLAN.md 2). The header's preference for paths with both transformations in a FrameSet search is not in C's FindFrame code, which takes the first match (docs/issues/c-library-quirks.md)

name: astNormPoints
note: Takes a PointSet, so no 8-byte variant or dimension arguments. C's public function reports AST__DIMIN for a coordinate count that differs from Naxes; the port reports Ncpin, as C's protected astNormalPoints does (PLAN.md 2)

name: astSetActiveUnit
note: C's header says a CmpFrame defaults to active units when both components use them, and that units with no Mapping between them raise an error; C's code uses either component, and treats such units as no match, as the port does (docs/issues/c-library-quirks.md)

name: Bottom
